text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal has the right sites in the right order and almost all the right parameters, but it leaves out details an automation would need: picking the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more, opening the first result each time, the \"do not Reserve/Book/Send\" limits, OpenTable by name and the party size there, the exact note/subject/body templates, and the explicit Discard step."}

data.rationale: The proposal has the right sites in the right order and almost all the right parameters, but it leaves out details an automation would need: picking the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more, opening the first result each time, the "do not Reserve/Book/Send" limits, OpenTable by name and the party size there, the exact note/subject/body templates, and the explicit Discard step.
